# GRU hidden-state oracle-accessibility audit report (spec v1.3)

Every scheduled output in S0, P, D and the report was produced.

C2 measures improvement beyond the declared input baselines under this split.
A gain is improvement under this feature-and-regularization procedure.
The input-only B_in+ → q calculation is a target-decoding calculation. It is not described as outcome-blind merely because it needs no checkpoint.
INIT, uniform weighting, the inner-λ sensitivity, AC|BD, T, R_exc, correlations and rank are descriptive and are not floor labels.
Unresolved cases are never counted as below-floor. INCOMPLETE cases are never counted as below-floor.
